author: springrool
body:
Why do i need to have a rank to buy the badge i want? :-:
Is there no  other way to buy a badge unless you have a rank?
Is it going to be like this for a long time/forever?

ive been saving up for a badge for over a year now and im not allowed to buy a rank.

replies.author: keenanjt
replies.body: We have been implementing more premium exclusive content to keep up with the server costs we are faced with! We offer a free service, but provide these types of things as a bonus for those that support the server.
